verified_scope: Historical source identity and visual design were inspected on 2026-10-19; this is not scientific validation, output-quality certification or a copyright license.
default_policy: When no user reference is supplied, render every one of the five verified style IDs once; variants within a family may be additional outputs. Bind private references locally before execution.

styles.name: FACT transaction and attribution cards

design_contract.composition: Dense rectangular scientific plate: a horizontal intervention sequence above grouped comparison panels and a lower calibration block. The companion overview uses a narrow source workspace, a top action/state strip and one enlarged detail.
design_contract.palette: White canvas, warm ivory cards, pale blue execution blocks, pale green states, muted lavender evaluation. Thin dark outlines; muted vermilion is reserved for attributed feedback or a specifically explained return route.
design_contract.components: Compact rounded cards, editable mathematical labels, small realistic software/video inserts, restrained black task icons, simple plots and aligned score boxes. Preserve meaningful multicolored internals.
design_contract.connections: Short thin dark directed arrows show actual transitions. Dashed dark leaders show magnification or grouping. A colored feedback route is permitted only with an explicit semantic explanation; arrows must touch intended ports without clipping.
design_contract.typography: Strong black sans-serif headings and body; mathematical italics only for variables. Equal-role labels share size, weight and alignment; preserve compact line spacing without touching glyphs.
design_contract.hierarchy: Top-row transaction, middle-row controlled comparisons, bottom-row model/calibration form three clear levels. Headings and lightly tinted bands separate roles without decorative empty regions.
design_contract.visual_semantics: Card fills encode stage roles; realistic inserts are observed artifacts. Solid arrows indicate execution/data flow, dashed leaders indicate detail views, and colored returns indicate attributed feedback only when the manuscript supports it.
design_contract.information_structure: Map the target manuscript into source, committed operation, execution evidence, state/result, judgment and downstream use when applicable. Do not transfer FACT-specific scientific claims or invent corresponding target stages.
design_contract.scale: Keep a compact full-width rectangle with consistent card gutters. Validate all text at the intended publication width and preserve high-resolution/vector typography; a reference screenshot's pixel size is not the export target.

styles.name: Thin dashed modular scientific architecture

design_contract.composition: Symmetric rectangular architecture with paired upper/lower modules on both sides and a narrow central interaction/verification spine. Use balanced columns and aligned module edges.
design_contract.palette: White canvas, muted olive/green and teal/cyan dashed group boundaries, pale blue/green/yellow/lavender component fills, sparse orange emphasis and black text.
design_contract.components: Fine outlined rectangular modules, filmstrip or evidence thumbnails, simple circular and line icons, compact tool/example grids and a central support/verification box; no unrelated cartoon replacement.
design_contract.connections: Thin black solid arrows for direct flow, deliberate dashed feedback paths routed along clear outer corridors. Keep arrowheads and stroke widths consistent and minimize bends; do not let routes deform the rectangular silhouette.
design_contract.typography: Serif scientific headings and mathematical symbols dominate this reference, with readable compact labels; retain one coherent type system and preserve superscript/subscript spacing.
design_contract.hierarchy: Colored dashed envelopes define major subsystems; inner pale panels define components; headings state roles; small thumbnails provide evidence detail.
design_contract.visual_semantics: Group outline color identifies subsystem role, while arrows express directional dependence and dashed paths express the named update/feedback relation. Each visual distinction needs a target-manuscript interpretation.
design_contract.information_structure: Use current/updated or before/after pairing only when it exists in the target information. Substitute target-compatible icons within the same visual grammar without dropping required information or copying unrelated labels.
design_contract.scale: Wide, compact and balanced: preserve paired-panel proportions, small internal gutters and publication-readable text. Sharpen/reconstruct native components instead of pasting blurry crop edges.

styles.name: Red and blue narrow-header evidence modules

design_contract.composition: Compact rectangular plate with a left source/evidence strip and stacked horizontal information rows, paired module header bars and narrowly spaced routing corridors.
design_contract.palette: White canvas; dark red and dark blue header bars with white labels; fine matching content borders; dark gray connectors and restrained green/orange accents only for distinct target roles.
design_contract.components: Flat narrow header bars, white text/content rectangles, small source evidence insert and small actor/tool glyphs. Each row contains actual information or interaction logic rather than an empty decorative box.
design_contract.connections: Short aligned gray solid arrows connect successive stages. Dashed arrows are used only for explicitly named contrast/alternative relations. Equal-role inter-row arrows should have equal visible length and aligned endpoints.
design_contract.typography: White bold sans-serif module labels, compact black scientific/content text, aligned row labels and controlled emphasis. Never fake dense unreadable prose or replace target equations with placeholder text.
design_contract.hierarchy: Saturated bars encode module identity, framed rows hold evidence/turn content, source strip anchors the visual narrative. Keep content blocks visually subordinate to labels but legible.
design_contract.visual_semantics: Red and blue denote two named functional roles, not automatically positive/negative judgment. Borders may distinguish content classes only with a stated target meaning; actor glyphs identify interaction sources.
design_contract.information_structure: Translate the target's own staged evidence and scoring workflow into the reference's row-based presentation. Maintain all source facts and formulas even if the reference originally depicted dialogue.
design_contract.scale: Preserve tight row rhythm and overall rectangular footprint while expanding for genuine target information. Create an HD reconstruction; the recovered 553x253 reference itself is low-resolution.

styles.name: Warm ivory persistent-workspace cards

design_contract.composition: Three major aligned vertical columns: narrow input, wide central persistent workspace and iterative panels, narrow evaluation. Subcards sit in a balanced rectangular frame.
design_contract.palette: Warm ivory and beige card backgrounds, desaturated taupe borders, near-black text, muted terracotta return routes and soft sage success panels. Small colorful evidence inserts remain colorful.
design_contract.components: Subtly rounded framed cards, inset workspace snapshots, compact tool lists, small round/revision cards, restrained realistic or clean line icons and small evaluation rows. Avoid unnecessary paper curls or heavy black edges.
design_contract.connections: Thin straight taupe forward arrows between major columns; muted terracotta feedback arrows with few purposeful bends inside reserved corridors. Keep endpoint attachments and arrowhead sizes uniform.
design_contract.typography: Clear compact sans-serif with strong dark headings, consistent row labels, centered stage tabs and readable italic annotations only where useful. Do not lighten or shrink labels to create artificial whitespace.
design_contract.hierarchy: Major column title, workspace subsection, smaller evidence/revision tiles, then fine explanatory annotations. Shallow fills and consistent borders establish grouping without excessive shadows.
design_contract.visual_semantics: Central workspace means persistence of the same underlying object across iterations. Return arrows must name the actual revision/update relation; evaluation colors must correspond to documented criteria.
design_contract.information_structure: Retain the target's source, persistent object/state, revisions and evaluation dimensions if present. A fit adjustment can replace icons or combine panels, but cannot invent iteration, omit required results or transfer the reference's video-specific claims.
design_contract.scale: Keep the central column materially wider than side columns, modest rounded corners and close but uncluttered gutters. Export large crisp text/edges and validate appearance at publication size.

styles.name: Blue-violet layered attribution and isometric tokens

design_contract.composition: Two verified layouts in one design family: a side-by-side comparison with isometric token chains and large bent arrows, and a detailed three-column mechanism plate with left internals, tilted central stacked evidence planes and right aligned explanation callouts.
design_contract.palette: White canvas; pale icy blue panels; medium blue and blue-violet arrows/highlights; pale sage attribution targets; dark outlines; sparse yellow lightning accents only where semantically justified.
design_contract.components: Isometric token cubes, tilted shallow evidence cards, compact attention/matrix blocks, highlighted spans, small bar charts and clean explanatory callout cards. Maintain the same projection and component rendering grammar.
design_contract.connections: Thick filled blue-violet arrow bodies with dark outlines for major routes, consistently sized heads and minimal smooth orthogonal bends. Thin local technical links may remain thin; do not replace all thick routes with unrelated single-line arrows.
design_contract.typography: Dark scientific serif-like labels in the source and clear mathematical notation. Headings are bold and readable; a target-specific explicitly requested unified sans-serif override takes precedence and must be recorded.
design_contract.hierarchy: Main mechanism emphasized by large spatial arrows and stacked central planes; internals in the narrow side panel; explanations aligned on the right. Compact details support the dominant visual route.
design_contract.visual_semantics: Highlights identify named target/source importance roles; layer stacking means repeated reasoning/aggregation only when the target logic supports it. Arrow width emphasizes a route, never invents a quantitative weight.
design_contract.information_structure: Use target-supported evidence, staged computations and results to replace the original reasoning-token story. Preserve every requested target information unit and explain every projection, highlight, card and line.
design_contract.scale: Keep the perspective shallow and consistent, the visual route balanced inside a rectangular plate and the internal details sufficiently large. Original concept attachment is 566x242; do not upscale that screenshot as a claimed HD final.
